_note: WARM PAPER scheme. The site was near-black with a bright teal for its first two years; this is the same identity inverted onto paper. The teal survives in two forms because one value cannot serve both surfaces: `accent` is it darkened to #2F756A, which is the LIGHTEST teal that clears 4.5:1 on both the paper and on white (4.80 and 5.42, solved rather than picked); `accentBright` is the original #5EEAD4, unusable as text on paper at 1.31:1 and perfectly good on the inverse blocks at 11.27:1. TWO faces, both SIL OFL and self-hosted: Gabarito for display (rounded geometric, and DUPLEXED -- see assets/fonts.css before you probe its weight axis) and Geist for body. Radii are large on purpose: this layout is built out of soft cards, and `lg` at 28px plus `xl` at 34px is what stops them reading as boxes. `accentSoft` is 0.08 and not 0.12 because the current-page nav pill sets accent text ON it: composited over the pill's translucent white over the paper, 0.12 measured 4.47:1 and failed AA by three hundredths. 0.11 is the highest alpha that still clears it, at 4.53, which is too thin to survive any later change to the pill or the paper; 0.08 gives 4.72. These values are this site's own, not extracted from any client or employer file.
